name: Semrush
description: Semrush gives you access to 28.6B keywords, 808M domain profiles, 142 geo databases, and 43T backlinks: the data behind every SEO, competitor, and market decision worth making. Target the right keywords, audit domains, track competitor performance, close backlink gaps, and fix technical issues. Track paid search moves and catch market shifts early. All in natural language: ask a question, get a structured answer built on real data. Built for SEO analysts, content strategists, marketers, and growth teams.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Semrush to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Semrush to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.semrush.com/claude/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Semrush MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Semrush lists 14 MCP tools, including execute_report, get_report_schema, audience_research, backlinks_research, competitors_research, domain_overview, keyword_research, organic_research, paid_search_research, position_tracking, projects, and shopping_research.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Semrush?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Semrush in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Semrush requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Semrush is developed by Semrush Holdings, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
